name: The Whispering Archive
description: A secret library hidden within a geode-cave, storing forbidden knowledge on Onieromancy and the Great Sundering.
full_description: Accessed through a hidden fissure in the Shifting Weald, this location is a cavern whose walls are embedded with massive, glowing crystals that hum softly. Instead of paper, knowledge is stored in 'Echo-Crystals' that project memories and information directly into a viewer's mind, a dangerous but precise practice. The few scholars who work here, known as the Quiescents, wear silver-threaded hoods to shield their thoughts. The archive is a trove of heretical texts and pre-Sundering histories, fiercely protected by the Vigil from those who would misuse its secrets. It is rumored to hold the original, flawed ritual that caused the Great Sundering.
